title: VisualIgnore
description: Take control of your social experience. VisualIgnore lets players make others completely disappear—blocking their character model, chat messages, private messages, and even PvP damage.
body:
## Take Control of Your Social Experience

**VisualIgnore** is the ultimate anti-harassment tool for your server. It allows players to completely remove another user from their sight and interactions, providing true peace of mind.

This is not just a chat filter—it's a complete social cloak.

---

### 🛡️ Core Features

* **Complete Visual Hiding**
    Use `/ignore <player>` to make their character model instantly vanish from your world.
* **Full Chat Mute**
    Automatically blocks all public chat messages from the ignored player.
* **Private Message Blocking**
    Stops the ignored player from sending you private messages (`/msg`, `/tell`, etc.) and prevents you from accidentally messaging them.
* **PvP Damage Nullification**
    Disables all PvP damage between you and the ignored player (both ways). They can't hurt you, and you can't hurt them.
* **Persistent & Saved**
    Your ignore list is saved in the config and automatically re-applied when you or the other player logs in.
* **Fully Translatable**
    All plugin messages can be 100% customized and translated in the `config.yml`.

---

### COMMANDS

* `/ignore <player>` - Hides the player and blocks all communication.
* `/unignore <player>` - Shows the player and allows communication again.
